_doc.comment: Single parameter file of the great_wave project. Every entry is an object {value, unit, provenance, comment}. Read it through gw.paths.load_params() / gw.paths.param(name). Same params -> same result: nothing may live only inside a .blend.
provenance_vocabulary: spec section N  = great_wave_blender_prompt.md, section N
orchestrator probe = measured by the workflow orchestrator before the agents started (environment / Alembic probe)
user chat message = the user's request that started this workflow (2026-09-20)
foundation default = chosen by the foundation agent; not from the spec; free to change (must not affect judged results)

WAVE_HEIGHT_M.provenance: spec section 4 (default 11 m; allowed 10.4-13 m = 0.8-1.0 x boat length 13 m, backlog 'okisa no settei')
WAVE_HEIGHT_M.comment: H = height from trough water level (Z=0) to crest. All shape work is done in H-normalised units and multiplied by H at the end.

painting_path.provenance: Clean 3859x2594 px reference downloaded on 2026-09-24 from Wikimedia Commons File:Tsunami by hokusai 19th century.jpg; SHA-256 30C170260DE393F51BD592ADACC6F0714B60F157C09744E9C5B6D46E6A613718
painting_path.comment: Project-relative clean painting for visual comparison and style studies. The official traced target is target/base_contour.json.

painting_width_px.comment: All 'left %' values of spec section 5 are relative to this width.

painting_height_px.comment: All 'top %' values are relative to this height. '1 % of image height' = 25.94 px is the unit of most tolerances (also for horizontal differences).

crest_left_pct.comment: Defining value of the painting frame: the crest sits on the X=0 plumb line. Derived numbers are computed in src/gw/frame.py, never stored.

crest_top_pct.comment: Defining value of the painting frame: the crest is at Z = H.

height_pct.comment: Defining value of the painting frame: trough-to-crest height as a fraction of the image height. Trough water level therefore sits at 8.7 + 66.0 = 74.7 % from the top.

total_frames.comment: Total length is fixed at 9.5 s; only the split between the three phases may follow the Houdini rhythm (to be reported to the user).

backlog_phase_seconds.comment: Initial split rise / overhang / curl-in. Any deviation derived from the Houdini reference has to be reported; the user decides.

S8_sample_spacing_pct.provenance: spec section 5 S8 and section 10 assumption 4 (initial value of the spec, NOT a backlog threshold)
S8_sample_spacing_pct.comment: Arc-length spacing of contour samples used for the tangent-difference smoothness test S8.

blender_exe.provenance: orchestrator probe (Blender 5.2.2 LTS, bundled Python 3.13 + numpy 2.3.4)
blender_exe.comment: Driven headless: blender.exe --background --factory-startup --python <script> -- <args>. No Blender MCP in this session.

houdini_abc_path.provenance: user chat message; orchestrator probe (Alembic 810 MB, one mesh 'filecache2', constant 611874 verts / 203958 tris, unshared-vertex triangle soup)
houdini_abc_path.comment: READ-ONLY. Motion reference ONLY (spec sections 1 and 6.1); never a geometry source.

houdini_fbx_path.provenance: user chat message; orchestrator probe (one static frame of the same mesh at 0.01 scale, no animation)
houdini_fbx_path.comment: READ-ONLY. Not needed for motion read-out.

houdini_abc_fps.comment: Scene frames 1..100. Bounding box at frames 75 and 100 equals frame 1, so the real motion span is shorter than 100 frames.

houdini_abc_frame_range.comment: Z-up after Blender import; bbox approx X -27.8..5.3 m, Y -15.4..15.4 m, Z -4.9..+6.1 m around frame 50.

ref_image_tank_frames.provenance: user chat message (attached image 1: six video frames (a)-(f) of a wave-tank experiment)
ref_image_tank_frames.comment: READ-ONLY, session-specific temp path. Dynamics reference only.

ref_image_houdini_viewport.provenance: user chat message (attached image 2: Houdini viewport screenshot = desired 3D look at the peak)
ref_image_houdini_viewport.comment: READ-ONLY, session-specific temp path. Per spec section 3 it is NOT a shape ground truth; never take shape data from it.

blend_dir.provenance: 2026-09-24 migration into the GreatWave_2026 Git repository; generated scenes remain local and ignored
blend_dir.comment: Project-relative directory for regenerable Blender scenes. Kept out of version control.

allowed_write_roots.provenance: 2026-09-24 repository migration; writes are restricted to this Blender project unless explicitly configured
allowed_write_roots.comment: gw.paths.assert_writable() always permits this Blender project; extra roots, if any, are resolved relative to this project. No old Claude scratch directory is required.

cam_print_distance_m.comment: CAM_print is orthographic, so its distance does not change the framing. The camera sits at Y = -distance and looks along +Y.

cam_print_clip_m.comment: Clip range of CAM_print; wide enough for any crest-line length discussed in spec section 7a.
